run_moviedialog_default_teacher: run the DefaultTeacher to train on all four MovieDialog tasks at once
run_moviedialog_task_teacher: run the TaskTeacher with moviedialog:task:N to load a single MovieDialog task
run_moviedialog_kb_teacher: run the KBTeacher to load movie knowledge base facts from movie_kb.txt
review_path_function: review the _path function to resolve datafile and candidate paths for a given task and datatype
review_tasks_dict: review the tasks dictionary mapping task numbers 1-4 to their dataset directory paths
